name: coinslot
description: Original terminal mini-games, each a Claude Code mod that runs in a pane beside the chat.

plugins.name: fish-shooter
plugins.description: An original arcade fish-shooter game for Claude Code. Aim a net cannon and catch fish. Pauses when Claude finishes; Claude's tool calls drop golden fish.

plugins.name: brick-breaker
plugins.description: An original arcade brick-breaker game for Claude Code. Bounce the ball and burst every brick. Pauses when Claude finishes; Claude's tool calls drop power-up capsules.

plugins.name: snake
plugins.description: An original snake game for Claude Code. Eat to grow and stay off the walls and your tail. Pauses when Claude finishes; Claude's tool calls drop glowing bonus food.

plugins.name: space-shooter
plugins.description: An original side-scrolling space shooter for Claude Code. Fly through waves and beat a boss every fifth wave. Pauses when Claude finishes; Claude's tool calls drop supply pods.

plugins.name: tap-flyer
plugins.description: An original tap-to-fly game for Claude Code. Thread your ember through gaps in scrolling pillars. Pauses when Claude finishes; Claude's tool calls drop glowing coins.

plugins.name: jump-runner
plugins.description: An original endless runner for Claude Code. Jump over crates and under drones as the pace climbs. Pauses when Claude finishes; Claude's tool calls drop glowing coins.

plugins.name: ci-smoke-bad
plugins.description: An original coin-collecting arcade game for Claude Code. Steer a dot to gather coins before time runs out.
